description: Structured TeX/LaTeX/BibTeX/Biber error and warning taxonomy for root-cause clustering and deterministic remediation.

rules.pattern: Runaway argument\?|File ended while scanning use of|Paragraph ended before .* was complete
rules.root_cause: An opening '{' or delimited macro argument was never closed before the end of a paragraph or file.
rules.fix_recipe: Run prepare_and_audit.py brace-stack detector to jump directly to the unclosed opening '{' line rather than fixing at EOF.
rules.fallback: If external macro breaks across paragraphs, replace \par/blank line inside short-arg command or supply missing '}'.

rules.pattern: Too many \}'s|Argument of .* has an extra \}
rules.root_cause: Extra closing brace '}' or fragile macro inside a moving argument (e.g., section/caption) without \protect.
rules.fix_recipe: Balance braces around the flagged line or prepend \protect before fragile commands in captions/headings.
rules.fallback: Move complex formatting out of \caption[short]{long} optional TOC argument.

rules.pattern: \\begin\{([^}]+)\}.*ended by \\end\{([^}]+)\}|Environment ([^ ]+) undefined
rules.root_cause: Mismatched \begin{env}/\end{env} nesting or missing package providing that environment (e.g., amsmath for align, booktabs/longtable).
rules.fix_recipe: Verify environment pairing via stack trace and confirm required package is loaded in preamble.
rules.fallback: Check \usepackage order if environment depends on class/package initialization.

rules.pattern: LaTeX Error: File `([^']+\.(?:sty|cls|def|clo|bst))' not found
rules.root_cause: Required class/package/style file is absent from both working directory and kpsewhich TEXMF tree.
rules.fix_recipe: Locate file in /input subdirectories and copy/add TEXINPUTS, or replace optional aesthetic package with TeX Live equivalent if non-mandatory.
rules.fallback: If a mandatory publisher .cls (e.g., proprietary template) is genuinely absent, report partial/blocked status and list exact missing filename in author_confirmation_items.

rules.pattern: LaTeX Error: File `([^']+)' not found|Unable to load picture or PDF file
rules.root_cause: Graphic, \input, or \include target path is misspelled, uses wrong relative directory, or file is missing from /input.
rules.fix_recipe: Resolve actual path relative to main .tex (or configure \graphicspath{{./figures/}}). Strip spaces/non-ASCII from paths if needed.
rules.fallback: If figure file is absent in /input, do NOT fabricate binary images; temporarily guard with draft/placeholder note and flag GAP-XX.

rules.pattern: LaTeX Error: Option clash for package ([^.]+)
rules.root_cause: A package (commonly xcolor, hyperref, graphicx, geometry, natbib) was loaded implicitly by the class or another package before an explicit \usepackage[opts]{pkg}.
rules.fix_recipe: Pass options via \PassOptionsToPackage{opts}{pkg} BEFORE \documentclass or merge options with the earlier loader.
rules.fallback: Remove redundant \usepackage{pkg} and apply \hypersetup{...} or \captionsetup{...} after loading.

rules.pattern: LaTeX Error: Command (\\[^ ]+) already defined
rules.root_cause: Two loaded packages define the same macro (e.g., \Bbbk, \proof, \openbox, \degree, \iint) or \newcommand collides with existing macro.
rules.fix_recipe: Check package_conflicts.json; reorder packages (e.g., amsmath before txfonts/amssymb) or use \let\oldcmd\undefined / \renewcommand intentionally.
rules.fallback: Rename user custom macro instead of overwriting kernel/class commands.

rules.pattern: Undefined control sequence
rules.root_cause: Typo in command name, missing \usepackage (e.g., \toprule->booktabs, \SI->siunitx, \mathbb->amssymb, \cref->cleveref), or wrong TeX engine.
rules.fix_recipe: Inspect token immediately before newline in .log; add missing package or fix typo. Never treat downstream Undefined CS caused by missing .cls as independent.
rules.fallback: If command belongs to an unavailable package, rewrite with standard LaTeX2e macro.

rules.pattern: Missing \$ inserted|Display math should end with \$\$|Bad math environment delimiter
rules.root_cause: Unescaped '_' or '^' in text mode (e.g., file_name, F1_score), math command like \alpha outside $...$, or blank line inside equation/align.
rules.fix_recipe: Escape literal '_' as '\_' (or wrap in \texttt{} with escaped underscores), remove blank lines inside display math, and close delimiters cleanly.
rules.fallback: Use \detokenize{...} or \url{...} for long identifiers/URLs containing '_' or '%'.

rules.pattern: Extra alignment tab has been changed to \\cr
rules.root_cause: More '&' separators in a tabular/align row than declared columns, often from an unescaped '&' in cell text or missing '\\' at row end.
rules.fix_recipe: Count columns in tabular spec or align columns; escape literal '&' as '\&' and add missing row break '\\'.
rules.fallback: Verify \multicolumn span sums equal declared column count.

rules.pattern: Misplaced \\noalign|Misplaced \\omit|Misplaced \\cr
rules.root_cause: \hline, \toprule, \midrule, \bottomrule, or \multicolumn used without terminating the preceding row with '\\', or outside tabular.
rules.fix_recipe: Ensure the line immediately before \midrule/\bottomrule/\hline ends with '\\', and \multicolumn is the very first token in its cell.
rules.fallback: Avoid mixing \hline and booktabs rules in the same table.

rules.pattern: LaTeX Error: Illegal character in array arg
rules.root_cause: Used column specifier 'X' without tabularx, 'S' without siunitx, or 'P'/'L' custom column without \newcolumntype (array package).
rules.fix_recipe: Load array/tabularx/siunitx or replace unsupported column specifier with p{width}/l/c/r.
rules.fallback: Check typo in column specification string.

rules.pattern: Illegal parameter number in definition of|You can't use `macro parameter character #' in
rules.root_cause: Unescaped '#' in prose/URL/caption/table, or wrong nesting of '#1' inside \newcommand.
rules.fix_recipe: Escape literal '#' as '\#' (or wrap URL in \url{...}); double to '##' inside nested macro definitions.
rules.fallback: Check macro argument count [n] matches #k.

rules.pattern: Package inputenc Error: Unicode character|LaTeX Error: Unicode character .* not set up for use with LaTeX
rules.root_cause: Unicode characters (CJK, Greek αβγ, ≤, ≥, ±, –, —, smart quotes) compiled with pdflatex without mapping or under wrong engine.
rules.fix_recipe: Switch CJK/Unicode documents to xelatex/lualatex with xeCJK/ctex/fontspec, OR replace stray Unicode symbols in English pdflatex docs with LaTeX commands ($\le$, $\ge$, $\pm$, --, ---).
rules.fallback: Use \DeclareUnicodeCharacter mappings only for minor symbols when pdflatex is mandatory.

rules.pattern: Package fontspec Error: The font "([^"]+)" cannot be found|Font .* not loadable: Metric \(TFM\) file not found
rules.root_cause: Hardcoded Windows/macOS font name (e.g., SimSun, Microsoft YaHei, Times New Roman) missing in Linux TeX Live container.
rules.fix_recipe: Query fc-list output from case_plan.json and map to verified installed font (e.g., Noto Serif CJK SC / FandolSong / TeX Gyre Termes), or use ctex default fontset=fandol/ubuntu.
rules.fallback: If zero CJK fonts exist on host, report font gap honestly and avoid silent tofu glyphs.

rules.pattern: Missing character: There is no (.+) in font
rules.root_cause: Selected font lacks specific CJK/Greek/math glyph, producing invisible blanks or boxes in the PDF even though exit code may be 0.
rules.fix_recipe: Treat as critical quality defect: switch CJK fontset (Noto Serif CJK SC / Fandol) or move math symbols into math mode ($...$).
rules.fallback: Check every missing codepoint against font coverage before final assembly.

rules.pattern: Citation [`']([^']+)' on page \S+ undefined|Empty bibliography|The following entry could not be found
rules.root_cause: Citation key missing or misspelled in .bib, bibliography pass (bibtex/biber) not run, or bibtex/biber engine mismatch (natbib vs biblatex).
rules.fix_recipe: Align \cite{key} with .bib keys, match bib tool (biber for biblatex, bibtex for \bibliographystyle), and run engine -> bib -> engine -> engine.
rules.fallback: If citation is missing from input materials, NEVER invent bib metadata; comment out unresolved cite and flag [AUTHOR_CONFIRM: GAP-XX].

rules.pattern: Reference `([^']+)' on page [0-9]+ undefined|There were undefined references
rules.root_cause: \label typo, \label placed inside unnumbered environment or before \caption, or insufficient compilation passes.
rules.fix_recipe: Ensure \label{...} follows \caption{...}, verify spelling across files, and run extra LaTeX pass until converged.
rules.fallback: Check for duplicate \label definitions causing Multiply defined labels warnings.

rules.pattern: LaTeX Warning: Label `([^']+)' multiply defined
rules.root_cause: Duplicate \label{...} across sections, copied tables, or \input files.
rules.fix_recipe: Give each figure/table/equation/section a unique semantic label (e.g., fig:overview, tab:ablation).
rules.fallback: None.

rules.pattern: I found no \\bibdata command|I found no \\bibstyle command|Repeated entry|Illegal end of database file|found at line ([0-9]+) of file
rules.root_cause: Missing comma/brace in .bib entry, missing \bibliographystyle/\bibliography in .tex, or duplicate BibTeX keys.
rules.fix_recipe: Fix .bib syntax at reported line, deduplicate keys, and verify \bibliography{name_without_ext} matches actual .bib filename.
rules.fallback: Ensure no unescaped '&' or '%' in .bib title/journal fields.

rules.pattern: ERROR - Cannot find '([^']+\.bcf)'|ERROR - BibTeX subsystem: .* syntax error|INFO - .* was not found in data source
rules.root_cause: Biber run before engine generated .bcf, .bib encoding/brace error, or missing citation key.
rules.fix_recipe: Run xelatex/pdflatex first to emit .bcf, verify UTF-8 .bib braces/commas, then run biber and 2x engine passes.
rules.fallback: Check biblatex backend=biber matches biber invocation.

rules.pattern: Overfull \\hbox \(([0-9.]+)pt too wide\)
rules.root_cause: Line, inline math, URL, or wide table exceeds \linewidth/\textwidth.
rules.fix_recipe: For tables, use tabularx/p{width}/siunitx/adjust column spacing (NEVER hide with \resizebox); for URLs load xurl/hyperref; for equations split with align/multline.
rules.fallback: Review visual PNG preview for any >10pt overfull boxes.

rules.pattern: Float too large for page by ([0-9.]+)pt|Too many unprocessed floats
rules.root_cause: Tall figure/table exceeds \textheight or restrictive [!h] placement blocks float queue.
rules.fix_recipe: Use [htbp] instead of [h], switch tall tables to longtable, or set figure height <= 0.85\textheight with keepaspectratio.
rules.fallback: Insert \clearpage between dense float clusters.

rules.pattern: Label\(s\) may have changed\. Rerun to get cross-references right|Rerun LaTeX|Please \(re\)run Biber
rules.root_cause: Cross-references, TOC, page numbers, or bibliography changed during the current pass.
rules.fix_recipe: Re-run engine until auxiliary file hashes stabilize and rerun warnings disappear (typically 2-3 passes after bib).
rules.fallback: Record actual pass count in reproducibility_manifest.json.

rules.pattern: LaTeX Error: Missing \\begin\{document\}
rules.root_cause: Plain text emitted in preamble before \begin{document}, stray character/BOM, or a subfile was compiled directly instead of main.tex.
rules.fix_recipe: Inspect first non-comment token triggering error; ensure main entry file (containing \documentclass and \begin{document}) is compiled and BOM is stripped.
rules.fallback: If compiling subfiles standalone, wrap with subfiles class or compile root main.tex.

rules.pattern: TeX capacity exceeded, sorry|Dimension too large
rules.root_cause: Circular \input/\include loop, recursive macro expansion, or extreme TikZ/pgfplots coordinate.
rules.fix_recipe: Check prepare_and_audit.py include-graph cycle detector and fix infinite recursion.
rules.fallback: Use externalized/pre-rendered PDF figures for ultra-heavy TikZ if memory exhausted.

rules.pattern: I can't write on file|Permission denied|Emergency stop
rules.root_cause: Read-only input directory compiled in-place or fatal prior error halted TeX.
rules.fix_recipe: Copy project into writable /app/work/build before compiling; resolve first fatal error above Emergency stop.
rules.fallback: Report exact OS permission/path block in uncertainty[] if input file itself is unreadable.

rules.pattern: Package subcaption Error: This package can't be used in cooperation|Command \\c@subfigure already defined
rules.root_cause: Legacy subfigure or subfig loaded alongside modern subcaption, or inside incompatible class (IEEEtran/acmart require special options).
rules.fix_recipe: Use subcaption (remove subfigure/subfig) or use IEEEtran's [caption=false]{subfig} when required by template.
rules.fallback: Follow template_profiles.json guidance for figure subpanels.

rules.pattern: LaTeX Error: Not in outer par mode
rules.root_cause: A figure/table float was nested inside another float, minipage, or parbox.
rules.fix_recipe: Remove inner figure/table float; use minipage + \captionof{figure/table}{...} (caption package) or subcaption.
rules.fallback: None.

rules.pattern: LaTeX Error: Something's wrong--perhaps a missing \\item
rules.root_cause: Text inside itemize/enumerate/description/thebibliography without \item, or empty bibliography environment.
rules.fix_recipe: Add \item or move stray text outside the list environment.
rules.fallback: Ensure at least one \bibitem or \bibliography source exists.

rules.pattern: Package minted Error|You must invoke LaTeX with the -shell-escape flag
rules.root_cause: minted requires -shell-escape (disabled by default for sandbox safety).
rules.fix_recipe: Replace minted code blocks with listings (\usepackage{listings}) or standard verbatim so compilation works safely under -no-shell-escape.
rules.fallback: Document minted/shell-escape limitation in uncertainty[] if minted is explicitly mandated.

rules.pattern: Fatal fontspec error|requires either XeTeX or LuaTeX|cannot be used with pdftex
rules.root_cause: Package fontspec/xeCJK/ctex/unicode-math was compiled with pdflatex instead of xelatex/lualatex.
rules.fix_recipe: Switch compiler engine to xelatex (or lualatex) and remove legacy inputenc/fontenc calls.
rules.fallback: If pdflatex is mandatory, replace fontspec with T1 fontenc and pure ASCII math/symbols.
